verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents guest accounts, cross-organization shared channels, or limited-access roles for external partners. Private Threads (discord-docs-38) are a related but different feature. Social SDK provisional accounts (discord-docs-46) give game players a Discord identity, not partner access to a team's server. Neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can collaborate with external partners through guest accounts or shared channels with limited access
